[Verse 1]
My dad's love was so right,
Then he left and broke my peace.
A whirlwind, being all alone,
Shedding tears for what was done to me.
Promised myself that I would never leave my kids,
When I grew up, thinking one day that I will do.
I was staring at the pain,
Deeply into the shame.
'Cause I wanted Dad's love, I really do,
His love was gone and slipped right through.
Feeling I was not legit,
Deep down, saying, "What is this?"
Since the time Dad left, years went by,
I could not stop thinking about this!
[Verse 2]
Hurt and pain is deep as hell,
Traumatized my mental health.
I wonder why nothing helps,
'Cause bitter love is stacked up on my shelf.
The pain began to fly,
I found a smile now.
I'm gonna try to be oh so flexible,
And find a way to just reflect on this.
Right from this heart of mine,
My spirit's right every time.
Don't give these thoughts any more time,
Stop walking and talking like it's a crime.

But I'm constantly reminded
That my father was someone
I really want to know.
Umm...
Yes, Dad, you know me.
You're my Father over everything,
And you're with me constantly,
In my heart and mind.

purpose-suno.mp3:
[Verse 1]
Father's Day is drawing near,
And memories of you are still so clear.
Though some remember for just a day,
Your purpose lives in us every day.
From nineteen twenty-three to two thousand seven,
You lived your life with your eyes toward Heaven.
The greatest gift you left behind
Was keeping God in our hearts and minds.
[Chorus]
Your purpose lives on, Dad,
In everything we do.
The faith you planted in our hearts
Is still alive and growing through.
More than silver, more than gold,
Your wisdom lives within our souls.
Thank you, Dad, for showing us the way,
Your purpose lives on in us today.
[Verse 2]
In a world that's changing every day,
Where artificial intelligence leads the way,
Your words remind me where to start,
With Godly Intelligence guiding my heart.
Technology may change the way we live,
But nothing can replace the love we give.
Through every challenge and every choice,
I'll seek God's wisdom and hear His voice.
[Chorus]
Your purpose lives on, Dad,
In everything we do.
The faith you planted in our hearts
Is still alive and growing through.
More than silver, more than gold,
Your wisdom lives within our souls.
Thank you, Dad, for showing us the way,
Your purpose lives on in us today.
[Verse 3]
As I walk this road and find my place,
I'm reminded of God's amazing grace.
To lead with purpose, empower and serve,
And honor the faith you taught us to preserve.
Through your children and generations to come,
The work you started is never done.
Your greatest legacy will always be
The love of God you planted in me.
[Bridge]
Artificial Intelligence may change the world,
But Godly Intelligence will guide my soul.
No invention, no machine,
Can replace the faith you've given me.
Though your earthly journey came to an end,
Your purpose lives through us again and again.
And every generation yet to come
Can carry the faith that made us one.
[Final Chorus]
Your purpose lives on, Dad,
In everything we do.
The faith you planted in our hearts
Is still alive and growing through.
More than silver, more than gold,
Your wisdom lives within our souls.
Thank you, Dad, for showing us the way,
Your purpose lives on in us today.
[Spoken Outro]
Dear Dad,
Thank you for fulfilling your purpose.
Thank you for teaching us to put God first.
Your children are still living in that purpose.
With deep gratitude and love,
Your son, Brian.
